*Source: [Ultimate Spheres of Power](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/300249/Ultimate-Spheres-of-Power?affiliate_id=549120)*

### Fey Blessing

**Blessing of the Sidhe (lesser):** You can touch a willing creature, giving it a blessing. For the next round, any time the target rolls a d20, he may roll twice and take the more favorable result.

**Summon Fey (major):** At 10th level, you can summon a fey creature as the Summon Fairy talent, using your warpriest level as your caster level, with a duration of 1 minute. This stacks normally with caster levels gained from other sources.
